last_modified_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the metadata source was modified the last time in DKG.
created_on: The timestamp (in UTC time standard) when the metadata source was created in DKG.
name: The name of the source system where the asset was created.
id: The globally unique id of the metadata source generated by DKG using uuidv5.
last_modified_by: The identifier of the user in DKG who modified the metadata source the last time.
display_name: The display name that will be used in UIs, e.g., marketplace, in title case.
created_by: The identifier of the user in DKG who created the metadata source.
